name: PLATO Non-Convex QUBO-QPLIB Benchmark
description: Evaluates global optimisation solvers on 23 unconstrained binary quadratic (QUBO) instances from QPLIB, where all variables are binary and the objective is non-convex quadratic. Solvers must find provably globally optimal solutions. The benchmark compares specialised QUBO solvers (BiqBin, QuBowl, McSparse) against general-purpose MINLP solvers (BARON, SCIP, SHOT) and commercial MIP solvers.
domain: optimization, quadratic programming, combinatorial optimization, operations research
typical_sota_score: Solvers solve 8–15 of 23 instances; scaled geometric means 1.0–6.69 seconds. 1-hour time limit, 12 threads.
reputation: Specialist benchmark for QUBO solvers; relevant to quantum computing communities as QUBO is the native problem form for quantum annealers.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. QUBO is the formulation used by quantum annealers (D-Wave). Problems from QPLIB (IDs 3506–5922). All instances verified to global optimality.
